head: A physical album with no grooves
line: Since Oct. 2, Luminate has tracked Smart Media Albums in the US and Canada.

head: What it is
line: A physical item with a QR code or NFC chip. Activate it and the album unlocks in an app or on a website.

head: First since the CD
line: It's the first new physical format Luminate has added since CDs. Eligible sales count toward Billboard's charts.
